verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 4.233
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 4.233

verses.pali: 24. Kammavagga
verses.english: 24. Deeds

verses.pali: Vitthārasutta
verses.english: Deeds in Detail

verses.pali: “Cattārimāni, bhikkhave, kammāni mayā sayaṁ abhiññā sacchikatvā paveditāni.
verses.english: “Mendicants, I declare these four kinds of deeds, having realized them with my own insight.

verses.pali: Katamāni cattāri?
verses.english: What four?

verses.pali: Atthi, bhikkhave, kammaṁ kaṇhaṁ kaṇhavipākaṁ;
verses.english: There are dark deeds with dark results;

verses.pali: atthi, bhikkhave, kammaṁ sukkaṁ sukkavipākaṁ;
verses.english: bright deeds with bright results;

verses.pali: atthi, bhikkhave, kammaṁ kaṇhasukkaṁ kaṇhasukkavipākaṁ;
verses.english: dark and bright deeds with dark and bright results; and

verses.pali: atthi, bhikkhave, kammaṁ akaṇhaasukkaṁ akaṇhaasukkavipākaṁ kammakkhayāya saṁvattati.
verses.english: neither dark nor bright deeds with neither dark nor bright results, which lead to the ending of deeds.

verses.pali: Katamañca, bhikkhave, kammaṁ kaṇhaṁ kaṇhavipākaṁ?
verses.english: And what are dark deeds with dark results?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco sabyābajjhaṁ kāyasaṅkhāraṁ abhisaṅkharoti, sabyābajjhaṁ vacīsaṅkhāraṁ abhisaṅkharoti, sabyābajjhaṁ manosaṅkhāraṁ abhisaṅkharoti.
verses.english: It’s when someone makes hurtful choices by way of body, speech, and mind.

verses.pali: So sabyābajjhaṁ kāyasaṅkhāraṁ abhisaṅkharitvā, sabyābajjhaṁ vacīsaṅkhāraṁ abhisaṅkharitvā, sabyābajjhaṁ manosaṅkhāraṁ abhisaṅkharitvā sabyābajjhaṁ lokaṁ upapajjati.
verses.english: Having made these choices, they’re reborn in a hurtful world,

verses.pali: Tamenaṁ sabyābajjhaṁ lokaṁ upapannaṁ samānaṁ sabyābajjhā phassā phusanti.
verses.english: where hurtful contacts strike them.

verses.pali: So sabyābajjhehi phassehi phuṭṭho samāno sabyābajjhaṁ vedanaṁ vediyati ekantadukkhaṁ, seyyathāpi sattā nerayikā.
verses.english: Touched by hurtful contacts, they experience hurtful feelings that are exclusively painful—like the beings in hell.

verses.pali: Idaṁ vuccati, bhikkhave, kammaṁ kaṇhaṁ kaṇhavipākaṁ.
verses.english: These are called dark deeds with dark results.

verses.pali: Katamañca, bhikkhave, kammaṁ sukkaṁ sukkavipākaṁ?
verses.english: And what are bright deeds with bright results?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco abyābajjhaṁ kāyasaṅkhāraṁ abhisaṅkharoti, abyābajjhaṁ vacīsaṅkhāraṁ abhisaṅkharoti, abyābajjhaṁ manosaṅkhāraṁ abhisaṅkharoti.
verses.english: It’s when someone makes pleasing choices by way of body, speech, and mind.

verses.pali: So abyābajjhaṁ kāyasaṅkhāraṁ abhisaṅkharitvā, abyābajjhaṁ vacīsaṅkhāraṁ abhisaṅkharitvā, abyābajjhaṁ manosaṅkhāraṁ abhisaṅkharitvā abyābajjhaṁ lokaṁ upapajjati.
verses.english: Having made these choices, they’re reborn in a pleasing world,

verses.pali: Tamenaṁ abyābajjhaṁ lokaṁ upapannaṁ samānaṁ abyābajjhā phassā phusanti.
verses.english: where pleasing contacts strike them.

verses.pali: So abyābajjhehi phassehi phuṭṭho samāno abyābajjhaṁ vedanaṁ vediyati ekantasukhaṁ, seyyathāpi devā subhakiṇhā.
verses.english: Touched by pleasing contacts, they experience pleasing feelings of perfect happiness—like the gods of universal beauty.

verses.pali: Idaṁ vuccati, bhikkhave, kammaṁ sukkaṁ sukkavipākaṁ.
verses.english: These are called bright deeds with bright results.

verses.pali: Katamañca, bhikkhave, kammaṁ kaṇhasukkaṁ kaṇhasukkavipākaṁ?
verses.english: And what are dark and bright deeds with dark and bright results?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco sabyābajjhampi abyābajjhampi kāyasaṅkhāraṁ abhisaṅkharoti, sabyābajjhampi abyābajjhampi vacīsaṅkhāraṁ abhisaṅkharoti, sabyābajjhampi abyābajjhampi manosaṅkhāraṁ abhisaṅkharoti.
verses.english: It’s when someone makes both hurtful and pleasing choices by way of body, speech, and mind.

verses.pali: So sabyābajjhampi abyābajjhampi kāyasaṅkhāraṁ abhisaṅkharitvā, sabyābajjhampi abyābajjhampi vacīsaṅkhāraṁ abhisaṅkharitvā, sabyābajjhampi abyābajjhampi manosaṅkhāraṁ abhisaṅkharitvā sabyābajjhampi abyābajjhampi lokaṁ upapajjati.
verses.english: Having made these choices, they are reborn in a world that is both hurtful and pleasing,

verses.pali: Tamenaṁ sabyābajjhampi abyābajjhampi lokaṁ upapannaṁ samānaṁ sabyābajjhāpi abyābajjhāpi phassā phusanti.
verses.english: where hurtful and pleasing contacts strike them.

verses.pali: So sabyābajjhehipi abyābajjhehipi phassehi phuṭṭho samāno sabyābajjhampi abyābajjhampi vedanaṁ vediyati vokiṇṇasukhadukkhaṁ, seyyathāpi manussā ekacce ca devā ekacce ca vinipātikā.
verses.english: Touched by both hurtful and pleasing contacts, they experience both hurtful and pleasing feelings that are a mixture of pleasure and pain—like humans, some gods, and some beings in the underworld.

verses.pali: Idaṁ vuccati, bhikkhave, kammaṁ kaṇhasukkaṁ kaṇhasukkavipākaṁ.
verses.english: These are called dark and bright deeds with dark and bright results.

verses.pali: Katamañca, bhikkhave, kammaṁ akaṇhaasukkaṁ akaṇhaasukkavipākaṁ kammakkhayāya saṁvattati?
verses.english: And what are neither dark nor bright deeds with neither dark nor bright results, which lead to the ending of deeds?

verses.pali: Tatra, bhikkhave, yamidaṁ kammaṁ kaṇhaṁ kaṇhavipākaṁ tassa pahānāya yā cetanā, yamidaṁ kammaṁ sukkaṁ sukkavipākaṁ tassa pahānāya yā cetanā, yamidaṁ kammaṁ kaṇhasukkaṁ kaṇhasukkavipākaṁ tassa pahānāya yā cetanā—
verses.english: It’s the intention to give up dark deeds with dark results, bright deeds with bright results, and both dark and bright deeds with both dark and bright results.

verses.pali: idaṁ vuccati, bhikkhave, kammaṁ akaṇhaasukkaṁ akaṇhaasukkavipākaṁ kammakkhayāya saṁvattati.
verses.english: These are called neither dark nor bright deeds with neither dark nor bright results, which lead to the ending of deeds.

verses.pali: Imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri kammāni mayā sayaṁ abhiññā sacchikatvā paveditānī”ti.
verses.english: These are the four kinds of deeds that I declare, having realized them with my own insight.”

verses.pali: Dutiyaṁ.
